payload.core_composition_summary: Sort points to form connected segments via adjacent difference check, then DP to store segment lengths, and hash map to translate query indices to sorted order.
payload.rationale: Solution combines sorting to order points, 1D DP to compute segment coverage, and a hash map to map original indices, enabling efficient O(P) queries.
